text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Thanks to you, I was able to get some much-needed rest!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: After a dip in the boilin' hot bath, I knocked back a tall, frosty glass of fruity milk! Aaand…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's a paradiiise! ♪ Paradiiise! ♪ Oasis of the shopping district! ♪ …Kinda thing.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Man, that bathhouse was just as advertised. You gotta come with me next time, 'kay?
